name: Do I need a permit to remove a shower in a Bay Area city like San Mateo?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to remove a shower in a Bay Area city like San Mateo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether a permit is required to remove a shower in Bay Area cities like San Mateo depends on the scope of work. Simple demolition without altering plumbing or structural elements may not require a permit. However, if the project involves relocating plumbing, changing the footprint of the bathroom, or any structural modifications, a permit is typically necessary. Always consult with your local building department or your contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permit requirements for shower removal depend on the project's scope, especially if plumbing or structural changes are involved. Consult your contractor or local building department.
